fusions.name: Smelled Out
fusions.desc: Lunges at the target and deals 15 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles. The target is left 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent Chase
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Draw First Blood
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% chance to critically heal. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Frenzied Pack
fusions.desc: When you strike, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
